description: Your listings on Neeed Directory, newest first: status, plan, badge, the admin's feedback when there is any, and the page to open. Pass a slug to get one. When next_page is a number, call again with that page for older listings.

page.description: The page to read, from 1 (the default), 100 listings each; ignored with a slug

name: my_listings

grace_ends_at.description: Revoked only: when the listing is hidden unless the badge is verified again

state.description: not_needed: Premium. verified: the link is dofollow. revoked: the badge disappeared from the site

plan.description: pending_payment: Premium was picked and is not paid yet

review_feedback.description: What the admin asked for or why they rejected it

status.description: live: public. in_review: waiting on a review. changes_requested: edit it to send it back. rejected: final. hidden_badge_missing: hidden until the badge is back and verified

url.description: The public page when live, the dashboard when rejected, the edit page otherwise

next_page.description: The page to ask for next, or null on the last page

total.description: Your listings across every page, or 1 or 0 with a slug

title: My listings
